### Passing Checks Summary
- **Correctness**: [`resolveBasePath`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L147-L165) and [`RouteResolver.resolve`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L225-L230) return `undefined` when an ancestor route has no registered path; [`RouteResolutionApiProxy`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx#L113-L171) implements `subscribe` and notifies listeners on `initialize()`; [`useRouteRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx#L38-L73) subscribes and re-checks resolution after mount.
- **Type safety**: Optional [`RouteResolutionApi.subscribe`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/apis/definitions/RouteResolutionApi.ts#L62-L69) and hook state are strictly typed without `any`.
- **Error handling**: Unregistered ancestor routes return `undefined` cleanly while parameterized parent routes still throw as expected.
- **Test coverage & docs**: Unit and integration tests in [RouteResolver.test.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.test.ts#L489-L504), [useRouteRef.test.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.test.tsx#L211-L271), and [createSpecializedApp.test.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx#L1921-L2044), documentation updates in [36-routes.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/docs/frontend-system/architecture/36-routes.md#L118) and [03-built-in-extensions.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/docs/frontend-system/building-apps/03-built-in-extensions.md#L106-L108), and changesets in [frontend-app-api-bootstrap-route-ref.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/.changeset/frontend-app-api-bootstrap-route-ref.md) and [frontend-plugin-api-route-ref-finalize.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/.changeset/frontend-plugin-api-route-ref-finalize.md) match [change_plan.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/.sdlc/runs/20261104-120000-bugfix-useroutref-startup/change_plan.md).
